verdict.rationale: Stripe's CLI docs offer a real sandbox environment (not just a dry-run or preview) for building and testing an integration, and Invoicing is built on the same Stripe API. The evidence is a single thin line: it does not say explicitly that the sandbox is isolated from live data, nor that invoicing flows can be exercised there. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that sandbox data is separate from production, invoicing-specific sandbox testing guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Create a sandbox: Start building on Stripe without needing to set up an account.
Build, test, and manage your Stripe integration from the command line.
